build_preprocess_pipeline: build a preprocessing pipeline from a pipe-delimited string of registered ops with optional arguments
create_registry_lookup: create a registry entry for a preprocessing op and look it up by name with arguments
test_parse_name: test the parse_name function to extract function name, positional args, and keyword args from a string
review_temporary_ops: review the temporary_ops context manager to register preprocessing ops for a scoped block
summarize_registry_knows: summarize the Registry.knows method to check if a preprocessing op name is registered
